g.text: 3-D STATE (review r2, close-out r3): parapet 29.10 m, roof deck (L9 = 8 x 3.34 m) 26.72 m, drum ring 31.00 m [obs photo a2, solved camera, 9 parapet columns;
absolute scale: Grand Hyatt top 44 m [inf, 40-48 -> -/+2.4 m]] - SUPERSEDES the 39.6 m NAIP drum-ring reading (dotted body).
Lean-model conflict, resolved [inf]: the NAIP drum band lies 13.25 m E of the outline arc; the NAIP frame model (spec naip.k_model,
ITB poles) gives 0.369 m/m here -> 35.9 m if the band were pure relief; that needs a Hyatt of ~51 m (outside 40-48).
Adopted: the a2 height, the band = relief 11.5 m + 1.8 m between the SFO Museum outline arc and the ring's outer edge [inf]; the Hyatt height (owner item OD-6) decides

g.text: 3-D STATE (review r2, close-out r3): parapet 27.52 m, roof deck (L9 = 8 x 3.16 m) 25.27 m, drum ring 29.42 m [obs photo a2, solved camera, 4 parapet columns;
absolute scale: Grand Hyatt top 44 m [inf, 40-48 -> -/+2.4 m]] - SUPERSEDES the 37.6 m NAIP drum-ring reading (dotted body).
Lean-model conflict, resolved [inf]: the NAIP drum band lies 12.00 m E of the outline arc; the NAIP frame model (spec naip.k_model,
ITB poles) gives 0.352 m/m here -> 34.0 m if the band were pure relief; that needs a Hyatt of ~51 m (outside 40-48).
Adopted: the a2 height, the band = relief 10.4 m + 1.6 m between the SFO Museum outline arc and the ring's outer edge [inf]; the Hyatt height (owner item OD-6) decides

engineer)

data, photos)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Notes
Massing elevations: width = the long side of the outline's minimum rectangle
(except: Garages A / G split into the garage body and the AirTrain guideway
tail of their outlines; the RCC drawn on its west-face chord), height = the
spec value with its tag; level lines only where a floor height is published,
else dotted placeholders. Facade modules are not dimensioned.
Garages A / G: the roof deck is still unmeasured: drawn dotted at the NAIP
drum-ring value (the ring is imaged with the same east lean as the deck edges,
i.e. level with the deck), with every candidate on the range bar; the helix
drum (outline arc) stands behind the SSE face; the 25-30 m AirTrain-photo
reading stays DISPUTED. Grand Hyatt: no published height.
DOF points are drawn at their positions projected on the face drawn (u from
the end named on the elevation); the RCC "TANK" is identified with the station
stair / elevator tower only by inference [inf].
